title: How Congress changed the Fed and defined the dollar
adds: Congress has repeatedly changed the Fed’s powers, governance and payment services. Federal law defines the dollar as a unit for stating amounts. A private dollar claim depends on its issuer’s promise to redeem it; it is not itself a Federal Reserve note.
